# [PR #2075] [Refactor] Phaseout legacy util `map_torch_type` with `T.dtype.as_torch`

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/2075
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-18T11:56:29Z
labels: 

## 正文

## Summary

`map_torch_type` was a standalone function that converted dtype strings or TVM `DataType` objects to `torch.dtype`. This was redundant since `T.dtype.as_torch()` (and `T.dtype(x).as_torch()`) already provides the same functionality with better handling (HIP/CUDA awareness, proper dtype lookup tables, etc.).

## Changes

- Remove `map_torch_type` from `tilelang/utils/tensor.py` and its re-export in `tilelang/utils/__init__.py`
- Make `T.dtype()` idempotent for existing dtype objects (add pass-through in `__dtype_new__`)
- Add backward-compat for `"e4m3fnuz_float8"` TVM internal name in `__dtype_as_torch__`
- Replace all usages across production code, tests, and examples
- Remove unused import from `cython_wrapper.pyx`
- Rebuild Cython extension

  * Unified dtype handling across examples, tests, and runtime to use the language-provided dtype conversion, improving consistency while preserving behavior and public APIs.

## Walkthrough

This PR replaces usages of the legacy `map_torch_type()` helper with TileLang dtype objects' `.as_torch()` conversion across examples, tests, and adapters, removes the `map_torch_type` definition/export, and adds minor dtype recognition/constructor tweaks in TileLang's dtype implementation.

## Changes

|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Examples** <br> `examples/deepseek_deepgemm/example_deepgemm_fp8_2xAcc.py`, `examples/gemm_fp8/example_tilelang_gemm_fp8_intrinsic.py`, `examples/gemm_fp8/example_tilelang_gemm_fp8_sm100.py`|Replaced `map_torch_type()` calls with `T.dtype(...).as_torch()` when creating/casting tensors and removed related unused imports.|
|**JIT tests** <br> `testing/python/jit/test_tilelang_jit_cutedsl.py`, `testing/python/jit/test_tilelang_jit_gemm_cython.py`, `testing/python/jit/test_tilelang_jit_nullptr.py`, `testing/python/jit/test_tilelang_jit_nvrtc.py`, `testing/python/jit/test_tilelang_jit_tvm_ffi.py`|Removed `map_torch_type` import and now derive PyTorch dtypes via `T.dtype(...).as_torch()` across multiple kernel execution paths before tensor allocation and kernel invocation.|
|**Kernel tests** <br> `testing/python/kernel/test_tilelang_kernel_bf16_gemm_mma.py`, `testing/python/kernel/test_tilelang_kernel_fp8_gemm.py`, `testing/python/kernel/test_tilelang_kernel_fp8_gemm_mma.py`, `testing/python/kernel/test_tilelang_kernel_fp8_gemv_simt.py`, `testing/python/kernel/test_tilelang_kernel_gemm_mma_intrinsic.py`, `testing/python/kernel/test_tilelang_kernel_gemv_simt.py`|Swapped `map_torch_type()` for `T.dtype(...).as_torch()` in correctness helpers to allocate/cast inputs, accumulators, and expected outputs.|
